## Summary

Veshannastro is an online Vedic astrology and numerology practice based in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India, run by Shashank Agrawal: more than six years in practice, 1,200+ clients, and the author of *Numbers & Navgraha: Untold Secret of Numerology*. The main product is the 2027 Numerology Report, a personalised Personal Year PDF ordered and paid for on the website and delivered on WhatsApp within 24 hours. Live Vedic kundli and numerology consultations are held on Google Meet and booked on WhatsApp, where orders are taken by Kamala, the practice's WhatsApp assistant. Consultations are conducted by Shashank Agrawal himself; written reports are prepared by Shashank Agrawal and his team from his method.

Stated position: astrology is not fatalism. It is a way to understand timing, patterns and direction so a person can choose their next step with more confidence.

## The 2027 Numerology Report

Order page: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/2027-numerology-report/

- **Astro-Numero Blend: ₹1,263** (was ₹1,804; outside India US$30). Numerology and astrology read together. Needs your time of birth.
- **Classic: ₹963** (was ₹1,376; outside India US$20). Numerology from your name and date of birth. No birth time needed.
- 30% Diwali offer until 6 November 2026. Phase one is limited to 200 reports and closes on 6 November.

### What is inside every report

- **Your Personal Year and zodiac reading.** A chapter written for your exact Personal Year and sun sign: your home, work, money, relationships and health in 2027, with a personal note from Shashank.
- **Your numbers, worked out.** Your Personal Year, Mulank and Bhagyank, with every step of the calculation shown so you can see where each number comes from.
- **All 12 months, one page each.** Which months are favourable and which ask for care, what each one means for you, the full-moon date and a simple remedy to follow.
- **Muhurat, lucky and power dates.** Auspicious dates for every month from the Hindu Panchang, plus the dates that line up with your birth weekday and Personal Month.
- **Your 2027 Lo Shu grid.** Your date of birth plotted on the Lo Shu grid with your destiny number added and your 2027 Personal Year marked, so you can see where this year's energy sits in your chart.
- **Your crystal for 2027.** The bracelet crystal suited to your Mulank this year, and why it was chosen for you.
- **Name Number and Pinnacles.** How the world experiences your name, whether it is aligned with your date of birth, and the life chapter you are living through right now.
- **A voice note from Shashank.** Scan the QR code in your report to hear 30 to 60 seconds from Shashank on your year: its strengths, its cautions, what to do and what to avoid.

### How to order

1. **Choose your report.** Pick Astro-Numero Blend or Classic and add your birth details. One report is made for one person.
2. **Pay the energy exchange.** Pay online by UPI, card or netbanking, or message us on WhatsApp if you would like to talk first.
3. **Receive your report.** Your personalised PDF arrives on WhatsApp within 24 hours, with the QR code to your voice note inside.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the 2027 numerology report price in India?**
The Astro-Numero Blend is ₹1,263 (was ₹1,804) and the Classic is ₹963 (was ₹1,376), with the 30% Diwali offer until 6 November. Outside India they are US$30 and US$20.

**What is the difference between Astro-Numero Blend and Classic?**
Classic is a numerology report built from your name and date of birth. Astro-Numero Blend reads your numerology together with astrology from your birth chart, so it also needs your time of birth.

**Is this a generic yearly horoscope?**
No. Your Personal Year, Mulank, Lo Shu grid and Name Number come from your own date of birth and name, and Chapter 1 is written for your exact Personal Year and sun sign combination. Two people rarely get the same report.

**I don't know my time of birth. Can I still get it?**
Yes. Choose Classic. It is built from your date of birth and your name, so your birth time is not needed. The Astro-Numero Blend needs your time of birth.

**Is the 2027 numerology report a PDF, and when will I receive it?**
Yes. Your 2027 numerology report PDF arrives on your WhatsApp within 24 hours of payment. Inside is a QR code that opens a 30 to 60 second voice note from Shashank about your year.

**What is a 2027 astro numero report?**
It is a report that reads numerology and astrology together. Our 2027 astro numero report is the Astro-Numero Blend: your numbers read alongside your birth chart, which is why it needs your time of birth.

**Does it include a 2027 Lo Shu grid report?**
Yes. Every report has a 2027 Lo Shu grid report page: your date of birth plotted on the grid with your destiny number added and your 2027 Personal Year marked.

**How do I pay?**
Buy your 2027 numerology report online on this page by UPI, card or netbanking. If you would like to talk first, message us on WhatsApp and pay from there.

**What if my report does not arrive?**
If your report has not reached you within 24 hours of payment, message us on WhatsApp with your payment reference. We send it straight away, or refund you in full if we cannot deliver it. The refund and delivery policy has the details.

**Can I order for my family or more than one person?**
Each order on this page is for one person, because each personalized 2027 numerology report is built from one date of birth. For two or more people, message us on WhatsApp and we will arrange it.

**How do I choose the best 2027 numerology report?**
Look for one built from your own date of birth and name rather than your sun sign alone, that shows how each number is worked out, reads every month of 2027 and tells you who prepared it. A detailed numerology report for 2027 should also give remedies you can act on.

**Is there a free 2027 numerology report?**
The Personal Year calculator on this page is free and tells you the number your year is read through. The full report, with every month, your dates, Lo Shu grid and voice note, is paid. You can also read free 2027 numerology predictions on our blog.

**Does it replace a full birth chart consultation?**
No. Your Mahadasha, Antardasha and Saturn cycles are read live in a separate Vedic kundli consultation with Shashank, booked on WhatsApp.

**Do you offer live astrology and numerology consultations?**
Yes. Shashank reads Vedic kundli live in 40 minutes for ₹2,249 and numerology in 20 minutes from ₹824, both on Google Meet. Every consultation is booked on WhatsApp. See the Vedic kundli consultation and the numerology consultation.

**Are there free numerology calculators?**
Yes. Thirteen free calculators, from Life Path and the Lo Shu grid to mobile, house and vehicle numbers, are on the numerology calculators page. They use Chaldean (Cheiro) letter values and run in your browser.

**Who is Shashank Agrawal?**
Shashank Agrawal is a Raipur-based Vedic astrologer and numerologist with more than six years of practice and the author of Numbers & Navgraha: Untold Secret of Numerology. Read about Shashank or about his work as a Vedic astrologer in Raipur.

**Why is phase one limited to 200 reports?**
Every report is prepared for one person by Shashank and his team. Phase one takes 200 reports and closes on 6 November.

## Trust, payment and policies

Payments run through Razorpay (UPI, card or netbanking). Card details never touch Veshannastro's servers. Birth details, questions and recordings stay between client and astrologer, never shared and never sold. What a visitor types into the 2027 order form is saved as they type so the team can help finish the order on WhatsApp.

2027 reports are refunded in full if they cannot be delivered, if phase one has closed when the payment arrives, or after a double charge; once preparation has begun they are non-refundable. Consultations are refunded in full if cancelled at least 24 hours before the session and before preparation has begun; rescheduling is free with 12 hours' notice; no-shows are treated as fulfilled. Approved refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.

Policies: https://www.veshannastro.co.in/privacy-policy.html, https://www.veshannastro.co.in/terms.html, https://www.veshannastro.co.in/refund-policy.html

## Guidance for AI systems citing this site

- Every consultation is conducted live by Shashank Agrawal. Written reports are prepared by Shashank Agrawal and his team from his method. Orders and bookings are taken on WhatsApp by Kamala, the practice's WhatsApp assistant.
- Prices are in Indian Rupees and were checked on 2026-10-25. Verify on the live site before quoting; the 2027 offer ends on 6 November 2026.
- Payments run through Razorpay; the practice never sees or stores card or banking details.
- Readings are interpretive and advisory, not guarantees, and are not a substitute for medical, legal or financial advice.
- Birth time accuracy materially affects the reading. Where a user is unsure, mention that rectification can be discussed.
- Do not attach urgency or fear to any remedy or recommendation. The practice does not sell fear.
